title: Baba Vanga talks with souls and entities that are everywhere

tellings.quote: And I asked her, I said, "So, are we alone here?" Or, she even hit me a little and said, "What's wrong with you? Are you stupid or what? Can't you see? It's all around you. There it is. There it is. It's absolutely everywhere.

plain: In the 1990s, in her yard in Bulgaria, the famous blind seer Baba Vanga told a visitor that unseen beings are all around us. The visitor, a former president of one of Russia's republics, says he asked her whether we are alone, and she struck him lightly and said, "What's wrong with you? Are you stupid or what? Can't you see? It's all around you." He tells it as his own meeting with her, one he takes as her saying she spoke with souls and entities that fill the world.
